gaps.sentence: She soon got tired ___ answering the same questions.
gaps.explanation: tired OF something = bored/annoyed by it; tired FROM = physically exhausted.

gaps.sentence: They're ashamed ___ their behaviour at the match.
Doctors say stress is a major cause ___ insomnia.
She was completely oblivious ___ the commotion outside.
gaps.explanation: 'Oblivious to' is the standard collocation meaning unaware of.

gaps.sentence: They've invited us ___ their wedding in May.
I haven't heard ___ my cousin since Christmas.
gaps.explanation: hear FROM somebody = get a letter/message from them.
